nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition via require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction via require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication via require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division guarded by require(b > 0).
Public constant totalSupply() returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw (unchecked) subtraction.
Public constant balanceOf(address tokenOwner) reading the balances mapping.
Public transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Public approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] unconditionally (no double-spend guard).
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender]; uses msg.sender as implicit spender.
Public constant allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) reading the allowed mapping.
Public approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowance then performs an external call into an arbitrary spender contract.
Payable fallback function that accepts ETH unconditionally with an empty body.
onlyOwner function that performs an external call to an arbitrary token address to transfer out tokens held by the contract.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner transferOwnership(address _newOwner): stages the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then finalizes the ownership handover.
Token constructor setting symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and minting the entire supply to a fixed address.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol eATN.
Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name eAccessTOKEN.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 8.
Public uint state variable _totalSupply, mutated by the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Private mapping(address => uint) balances tracking token ownership.
Private mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed tracking approvals.
Public address state variable 'owner' used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Public address state variable 'newOwner' used as the pending owner in the two-step ownership transfer.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balance ownership, allowance keys and access-control checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary, attacker-chosen contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, attacker-supplied token contract.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() (no SafeMath, no require).

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the account key when debiting balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the owner key when writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender is written into allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
msg.sender is the implicit spender whose allowance is debited in allowed[from][msg.sender].
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before finalizing the handover.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
owner state variable is the reference value compared with msg.sender in onlyOwner.
owner state variable guards the privileged transferAnyERC20Token entry point.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
newOwner gates acceptOwnership, so only the pending owner can complete the transfer.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the value of newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0).
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary spender contract after updating allowance, giving external code control.
The called spender contract can reenter transferFrom/approve before the allowance update is fully settled.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary token contract, handing control to untrusted code.
A malicious tokenAddress contract can reenter token state-changing functions such as transfer during the external call.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] before debiting the spender allowance.
transferFrom reduces the allowance stored in the allowed mapping.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transfer writes the updated balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom writes the updated balances for source and destination.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
transfer delegates the sender debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for the balance debit and allowance reduction.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply performs a raw unchecked subtraction without SafeMath, allow arithmetic issues.
balances[address(0)] is subtracted from _totalSupply without an underflow guard.

Constructor assigns the decimals value.
transfer recipient parameter feeds the balance credit.
transfer amount parameter feeds safeSub/safeAdd.

transferFrom 'to' parameter receives the credited balance.
transferFrom 'tokens' parameter determines the debited amounts.

transferOwnership parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.

transferAnyERC20Token tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'to' exists only to identify the credit target inside transfer; fold into the enclosing function node.
Parameter 'tokens' is only meaningful as the amount argument handled by transfer.
Parameter 'from' is only used inside transferFrom as the debited account and allowance owner.
Parameter 'to' is only used inside transferFrom as the credited account.
Parameter 'tokens' is only used inside transferFrom for the debit, allowance reduction and credit.
Parameter 'spender' has no standalone semantics outside approve.
Parameter 'tokens' is only the allowance value written by approve.
Parameter 'spender' directly determines the target of the external receiveApproval call, so it normalizes onto that unsafe operation.
Parameter 'tokens' is only the allowance/forwarded amount of approveAndCall.
Parameter 'data' is forwarded unchanged into the external call payload, best merged with that unsafe operation.
Parameter '_newOwner' only exists to set the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' is the arbitrary external contract target of the ERC20 transfer call.
Parameter 'tokens' is only forwarded as the amount of the external ERC20 transfer call.
